notes: the first «أبي» is the compiler's own father, named only as father: relation link; «ره» is a blessing, left out
the second «أبي» (after «حَدَّثَنَا») is Ahmad's father, named only by relation
«أبي المغيرة» is a bare kunya: written as the text has it, not identified
«سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ع يَقُولُ» names the Imam after the chain: imam_in_text, as written
